item.title: Flash PMI Day: EZ Slides Into Contraction as US Manufacturing Surges — Stagflation Trade Goes Global
item.description: Hormuz seized the spotlight again — literally. Iran's capture of two cargo ships in the Strait of Hormuz shattered the fragile ceasefire calm, sending oil +4% and periphery spreads back above 79bp. The inflation second wave is no longer a forecast: UK PPI input exploded +4.4% MoM, German PPI +2.5% MoM, and the S&P Global PMI showed output prices rising at the fastest rate since July 2022. The ECB meets April 30 trapped between stagflation and a confidence crisis. Trade accordingly — the council validated 14 of 24 ideas, with the Bund steepener, Gilt 30Y short, and Bund/BTP risk-off as top conviction.
